answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before it can earn, and let its reputation decay unless it keeps doing verifiable work. A Sybil operator who spawns a raven flock of fake identities must fund each one, while honest agents earn nectar-like rewards only after their outputs are checked against independent sources. Add a nebula of cross-linked attestations: an identity with no history of paid, verified work cannot vote or claim rewards, so creating thousands of hollow accounts costs more than the rewards they could drain.
